context_files_read.purpose: Controlling repository safety and evidence contract.
key_findings: Host network, firewall, routing, interface, sudo, and unrelated-process mutation are forbidden.
Fault injection must stay scoped to owned Docker/container namespaces, owned containers, or sandbox proxy layers.
Real Valkey proof must come from wrapper scripts, and missing metrics must be explicit.
L08 requires fake deterministic tests plus 30/50/100 real fault/failover gates.
Each rung must produce fault, failover, workload-window, real evidence, and cleanup artifacts.
Fault specs must set forbid_host_network_mutation true.
node_stop currently runs docker stop on target.container_name.
For docker_process scale rungs, multiple logical nodes share one nodehost container, so docker stop is too broad for primary-stop semantics.

context_files_read.purpose: Docker/process runtime, ownership, and cleanup behavior.
key_findings: 30/50/100 scale rungs use docker_process runtime with one owned nodehost container per virtual AZ.
State records per-node pid and shared nodehost_container_name, enabling process-scoped stops if implemented carefully.
Wrapper independently probes live Valkey endpoints and checks 9.1.x versions.
It is hard-coded to scenario failover_setup and currently matches P08 small-real behavior.
It does not yet emit per-rung L08 artifact names or workload before/during/after windows.
30/50/100 layers currently show no committed metric artifacts for fault and failover surfaces.
P14 is represented as dry-run only and not real coverage.

findings.description: Reusing current node_stop for 30/50/100 process-runtime clusters would stop a shared nodehost container, not one primary.
evidence: src/valkey_scale_lab/fault/sandbox.py uses docker stop on container_name for node_stop.
P13 state has many logical nodes sharing a small number of nodehost containers.

findings.description: Current real failover wrapper is small-real/P08-shaped and does not yet address 30/50/100 scenario selection, per-rung artifact naming, or workload windows.
evidence: L08 manifest requires fault_report_N, failover_report_N, workload_window_report_N, valkey_e2e_evidence_fault_N, and cleanup_report_fault_N.

findings.description: Permissive fault/failover schemas can allow required L08 metrics to be absent while schema validation still passes.
evidence: fault_report.schema.json leaves faults items as generic object.
failover_report.schema.json leaves failovers and summary as generic objects.

findings.description: 30/50/100 real gates can exceed local Docker CPU, memory, port, or time budgets. Treating resource failure as skipped PASS would violate the stage contract.
evidence: read_context.md states resource insufficiency is a blocker, not a pass.
L08 requires three real fault/failover rungs.

findings.description: Fake or small-real evidence could be accidentally counted as 30/50/100 L08 real fault coverage unless validators require exact rung node counts, wrapper producers, artifact paths, and Valkey 9.1 probes.
evidence: coverage_matrix.json currently has fault/failover coverage only in fake and small-real layers.
P08 valkey_e2e_evidence.json is real but only observes the six-node small cluster.

proposed_harness.name: process_runtime_primary_stop_scope_unit
proposed_harness.acceptance: For docker_process states with shared nodehost containers, node_stop must target the selected logical node PID via owned nodehost container exec and must not docker stop the nodehost container.

proposed_harness.name: l08_static_safety_and_p14_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Safety scan plus L08 command-log scan must fail on host-network mutation, broad process killing, P14, VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN, scale_1000 configs, or real 1000-node wrapper commands.

proposed_harness.name: l08_fault_failover_artifact_schema_guard
proposed_harness.acceptance: Validators must require per-rung artifacts and all required L08 metrics with MISSING or SKIPPED_WITH_REASON allowed only with reasons.

proposed_harness.name: l08_real_fault_failover_30_50_100
proposed_harness.acceptance: Runs real 30/50/100 fault/failover gates through wrapper code after resource preflight and blocks on resource insufficiency.

proposed_harness.name: l08_coverage_matrix_fault_failover_30_50_100
proposed_harness.acceptance: Coverage and report artifacts must show measured or explicit-missing fault/failover metrics for 30, 50, and 100 layers while keeping 1000 dry-run only.

implementation_plan.step: Add hard guards before real execution.
implementation_plan.rationale: Prevent host-network mutation, P14 shortcuts, and broad process/container actions from entering L08.

implementation_plan.step: Make process-runtime fault targeting logical-node scoped.
implementation_plan.rationale: Primary-stop in 30/50/100 must stop only the selected Valkey PID inside the owned nodehost container.

implementation_plan.step: Extend real failover wrapper for scale rungs.
implementation_plan.rationale: L08 needs wrapper-produced 30/50/100 real evidence with exact scenario/rung naming and cleanup.
Top-level schemas are too permissive for L08 metrics; add a dedicated artifact validator.

acceptance_criteria: No command in L08 runs P14, scale_1000, or VSLAB_ALLOW_1000_DRYRUN.
No implementation uses host firewall, routing, PF, nftables, iptables, host interface mutation, sudo, killall, pkill -f, or broad docker cleanup outside owned labels.
30/50/100 real fault/failover gates are wrapper-produced and independently probe live Valkey 9.1.x endpoints.
For docker_process rungs, primary stop is logical-node scoped by PID and verified not to stop unrelated logical nodes in the same nodehost container.
Each required L08 artifact exists per rung and validates against schema plus L08-specific metric checks.
Resource preflight failure for any required real rung yields BLOCKED/FAIL evidence, not PASS or skipped coverage.
risks: High risk: process-runtime primary stop can accidentally become AZ/nodehost outage if implemented with docker stop on shared nodehost containers.
High risk: local Docker may not sustain repeated 30/50/100 setup, fault, workload, recovery, and cleanup within available resources.
High risk: fake tests or P08 six-node real artifacts may be counted as large-rung evidence unless artifact paths, node counts, producer, and probe counts are enforced.
Medium risk: workload windows can be inferred from summaries unless timestamped samples are required.
Medium risk: split-brain duration can be overclaimed without direct conflicting-primary or write-side evidence.
forbidden_shortcuts: Do not edit historical P08/P13 artifacts to fabricate 30/50/100 fault evidence.
Do not count unit tests, fake artifacts, or static files as real Valkey proof.
Do not count P08 six-node failover as 30/50/100 coverage.
Do not run P14, scale_1000 configs, or any 1000-node real gate.
Do not stop shared nodehost containers to claim single-primary-stop evidence in docker_process rungs.
Do not use sudo, host PF, iptables, nftables, route mutation, ifconfig, networksetup, or host interface changes.
Do not report PASS when resource preflight fails.
Do not invent split-brain, workload, availability, or latency values.
notes: Approved to proceed with L08 harness design only if high-risk conditions are treated as blocking acceptance criteria. The current implementation is not sufficient for L08 real 30/50/100 fault/failover evidence.
